newsitem.title: USA: InterDigital gets $43 million Pakistan phone order.
newsitem.headline: InterDigital gets $43 million Pakistan phone order.

text.p: InterDigital Communications Corp. said Wednesday it received a $43 million order from Pakistan Telecommunication Co. Ltd. for its digital wireless local loop systems.
An IDC spokeswoman said the Pakistan order and a $600,000 order from Telecom Namibia are the first two to be obtained through IDC's alliance with Siemens AG.
Deliveries are expected to commence in the second half of 1997 and continue into 1998.
King of Prussia, Pa.-based IDC develops advanced wireless telecommunications systems using proprietary digital technologies for voice and data communications.

The order from the state-run Pakistan Telecommunication follows a Sept. 7 Reuter report in which U.S. Assistant Secretary of Commerce Raymond Vickery said a deal was close for IDC to provide 30,000 new telephone lines in Pakistani villages.
The order is subject to final commitment of financing through the Export-Import Bank of the United States.
IDC's stock rose 6.25 cents to $7.9375 on the New York Stock Exchange.
